doc: aither-license-lifecycle(7). Vendor policy installed at /usr/share/aither/license-lifecycle.json and read by awnix-renewal. Expiry NEVER stops serving; only the stops_after_grace rows stop, and only after grace_days.

keeps_serving.what: Every service already running keeps running: no unit is stopped, masked or made read-only.
Local models keep answering on the box.
Baked and already-installed components keep running and are never removed.
The on-box console and its sign-in keep working.
The local API and data export keep working; your data is never locked.
bootc rollback to any deployment already on the disk keeps working.
License import and renewal keep working, online and offline.

stops_after_grace.what: Online image updates (awnix update check/apply) are refused.
Private registry pulls stop: no new pull credential is issued.
Installing a licensed component that is not already on the box is refused.
New licensed packs cannot be added.
Vendor support and new offline bundles built after the grace end are not provided.
